{{velocity output="false"}} ## Shared by the measure sheet, the creation form and the listing.
## A sheet is complete when every R1 field except the source key is filled and at least one provenance names its data ## item and its sender. Keep in step with is_complete() in tools/wikidb/measures.py. #macro (mesureComplete $mesureDoc $return) #set ($complete = false) #set ($mesureObj = $mesureDoc.getObject('Mesures.Code.MesureClass')) #if ($mesureObj) #set ($complete = true) #foreach ($field in ['dateCreation', 'vecteurJuridique', 'raisonEtre', 'modalitesModification', 'documentationInterne', 'documentationExterne']) #if ($stringtool.isBlank("$!mesureObj.getValue($field)")) #set ($complete = false) #end #end #set ($withProvenance = false) #foreach ($provenance in $mesureDoc.getObjects('Mesures.Code.ProvenanceClass')) #if ($stringtool.isNotBlank("$!provenance.getValue('donnee')") && $stringtool.isNotBlank("$!provenance.getValue('emetteur')")) #set ($withProvenance = true) #end #end #set ($complete = $complete && $withProvenance) #end #setVariable ("$return" $complete) #end
## Owning bureau and perimeter come from the location Mesures.<code>.<Secteur|Synthese>.<page> (KTD6). #macro (mesurePlace $mesureDoc $return) #set ($place = {}) #set ($spaceRefs = $mesureDoc.documentReference.spaceReferences) #if ($spaceRefs.size() == 3 && $spaceRefs.get(0).name == 'Mesures') #set ($place = {'bureau': $spaceRefs.get(1).name, 'perimetre': $spaceRefs.get(2).name}) #end #setVariable ("$return" $place) #end
## Registry as code -> {name, type}, sorted by code. Agents cannot view WikiDB.Bureaux, so it is read with the ## rights of this page's author. #macro (mesureBureaux $return) #set ($registry = {}) #set ($registryDoc = $xwiki.getDocumentAsAuthor('WikiDB.Bureaux')) #set ($entries = $registryDoc.getObjects('WikiDB.Code.BureauClass')) #set ($codes = []) #foreach ($entry in $entries) #set ($discard = $codes.add("$!entry.getValue('code')")) #end #foreach ($code in $collectiontool.sort($codes)) #foreach ($entry in $entries) #if ("$!entry.getValue('code')" == $code) #set ($discard = $registry.put($code, {'name': "$!entry.getValue('name')", 'type': "$!entry.getValue('type')"})) #end #end #end #setVariable ("$return" $registry) #end
#set ($mesurePerimetres = {'Secteur': 'Sectoriel', 'Synthese': 'Synthèse'}) {{/velocity}}
